label: Quotient Audience — Company
description: Quotient's company page (a real capture, anonymized: 'Northwind', northwind.co): the Deals card, the Activity feed of everyone at the company grouped by day, Company Details (industry chips, location, employees, revenue) and the People list. THE ACTIVITY FEED IS SCRIPTABLE: data.activity (or {action:'activity'} rows in data.script) lands new events at their `at` -- each row is cloned from a real row, filled in, and inserted at the top of the day group its date belongs to (a new day gets its own header, in date order). Every event type: email_sent, email_delivered, email_opened, email_clicked, email_replied, email_bounced, unsubscribed, page_view, form_submitted, signup, meeting_booked, deal_stage_changed, crm_event, lead_score_changed, list_added, property_updated, flow_entered, product_event, custom. Signals from anywhere read as one timeline: a page view (source 'Website'), a deal stage change (detail 'Qualified -> Proposal', source 'HubSpot'), a product event (name 'First campaign sent', source 'Product'), the email Quotient sent back. data.focus 'feed' fills the box with the feed (top aligned, where new rows land) -- use it for a split's top half; 'details' the right column; default shows the whole page. A company feed is many people: give each event an actor (initials follow). company_name renames the company everywhere; data.details sets Company Details values by label.
